topic: Life categories, life latitude, review of life, log card updation and (I) NAMO/G/40, (I) NAMO/G/5
syllabus_extract: Life categories, life latitude, review of life, log card updation and (I) NAMO/G/40, (I) NAMO/G/5.
specific_objectives: 1.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to understand modification, life categories and flight-testing effect of CG variation and wartime maintenance procedure.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of Log Card entries and verification of Life Latitude calculations against (I) NAMO/G/40 and (I) NAMO/G/5 guidelines.
intro_questions: What are the three primary life categories defined in the syllabus?
How does CG variation affect flight testing procedures?
What is the significance of reviewing life before maintenance?

development.content:
Modification impact on aircraft life
Definition of life categories
Flight-testing effect of CG variation
Wartime maintenance procedures

Review of life calculation methods
Log card updation procedures
Interpretation of (I) NAMO/G/40
Interpretation of (I) NAMO/G/5

Integration of life latitude concepts
Verification of maintenance records
Application of wartime procedures
Summary of life categories

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between life latitude and maintenance scheduling.
Describe the steps required for accurate log card updation.
How do (I) NAMO/G/40 and (I) NAMO/G/5 guide life review?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts covered in this lesson will be applied in the upcoming lesson on Flight testing of naval aircraft (LP 02).

pft_rows.syllabus: Flight testing of naval aircraft, Maintenance Test Flight, Check Test Flight and documentation.
